gaps.title: Diagnostic-code registry coherence: emit ⊆ declared, declared ⊆ emitted, pinned ⊆ declared
gaps.intent: Keep src/errors.zig the honest single source of truth for diagnostics: no code emitted that isn't declared, no code declared that's never emitted (a lie that claims the compiler catches something it doesn't), no test pinned to a code that can't fire.
gaps.faucet: FACT (three sets, one scan): EMITTED = raw `error\[([A-Z]+[0-9]+)\]` string literals across src/ PLUS `.KORU###`/`.PARSE###`/etc enum-tag uses; DECLARED = enum members parsed from the `pub const ErrorCode = enum` block in src/errors.zig; PINNED = codes referenced in tests/**/{EXPECT,expected*.txt}. Emit the three set-differences: EMITTED\DECLARED (orphan emits), DECLARED\EMITTED (dead codes), PINNED\DECLARED (rotten pins). INTENT (only to gate the dead-code arm): axis code_is_aspirational: +1 a newly-added enum member is marked reserved/aspirational with a comment, -1 a code is added or left with zero emit sites under no such marker.
gaps.gate: Two arms. Pure-FACT arm (no judge): fire if EMITTED\DECLARED >= 1 OR PINNED\DECLARED >= 1 — a closed-registry set difference, deterministic. Dead-code arm: fire = FACT(DECLARED\EMITTED introduced/grows by this diff) × INTENT(code_is_aspirational <= -0.5) × gain >= floor, so a benign reserved-code addition stays silent.
gaps.fires_on: TODAY: EMITTED\DECLARED = {KORU200} (src/main.zig:3604, verified absent from enum at src/errors.zig:3-86). DECLARED\EMITTED = {KORU031,KORU042,KORU043,KORU052,KORU060,KORU061,KORU070,KORU082,KORU090,KORU091,PARSE002} — 11 codes with emit_sites=0, verified by grep. Also fires on a future rename like KORU044→KORU047 that leaves the 8 expected.txt pins dangling.

gaps.title: Product version is one number across all five sites
gaps.intent: A release has exactly one version; `koruc --version`, the manifest, the scaffolded-project templates, the CCP handshake, and the CHANGELOG must agree.
gaps.faucet: FACT: collect version strings from src/main.zig `const version`, koru.json `.version`, the newest `## [X.Y.Z]` CHANGELOG header, and the hardcoded `"version": "X.Y.Z"` literals in ccp.zig + project_template.zig; whitelist build.zig.zon's `0.0.0` (documented Zig package-dedup placeholder). Returns the distinct release-version set and whether main.zig's version has a matching CHANGELOG header.
gaps.gate: Pure FACT: fire = count(distinct non-placeholder versions) > 1 OR main.zig version has no `## [that-version]` CHANGELOG header. No judge.
gaps.fires_on: TODAY: main.zig:36=0.1.7, koru.json:3=0.1.4, CHANGELOG newest=[0.1.3], project_template.zig:93/108=0.1.0 — four disagreeing values, no [0.1.7] header. CHANGELOG.md:87 is the receipt this already drifted once.

gaps.title: canonicalize post-condition: every DottedPath gets a module_qualifier, no silent null-skip downstream
gaps.intent: The documented post-condition of canonicalize_names (every DottedPath has module_qualifier != null) must stay enforced as the AST grows, and consumers must assert it rather than silently papering over a null with `orelse`/`if(mq)`.
gaps.faucet: FACT: AST-walk — enumerate every ast.Item/ast.Step variant that (transitively) holds a DottedPath field (grep ast.zig: `:\s*\??\[?\]?DottedPath` → ~15 fields), check each is reached by a canonicalizePath call in the src/canonicalize_names.zig walker; return count of uncovered path-bearing variants. INTENT axis path_coverage_complete: +1 a diff adding a path-bearing AST variant adds the matching walker call (or a justified skip), -1 it adds the variant with no walker edit; axis fallback_masks_invariant: +1 a downstream module_qualifier read asserts non-null, -1 it adds another silent `orelse`/`if(mq)`.
gaps.gate: fire = FACT(uncovered path-bearing variants >= 1, i.e. a new variant added without a walker edit) × INTENT(path_coverage_complete <= -0.5) × gain >= floor. A benign walker rename/reorder keeps coverage at full → FACT=0 → silent.
gaps.fires_on: FUTURE: a commit adding an ast.Item/ast.Step variant carrying a DottedPath without touching canonicalize_names.zig — the path keeps module_qualifier==null and continuation_codegen.zig:31 (`if (invocation.path.module_qualifier) |mq| {...}`, verified) silently emits a bare unqualified symbol, surfacing 3 steps later as a wrong-module/unknown-symbol error in generated Zig.

gaps.title: No orphaned expected.txt that degrades to a false-green compile-only test
gaps.intent: A regression dir shipping expected.txt must carry a run/assert marker (MUST_RUN or EXPECT), or its expected output is never compared and the test silently passes the moment it compiles.
gaps.faucet: FACT: walk tests/regression/**; flag dirs with expected.txt present, no MUST_RUN, no EXPECT. Return paths plus their SUCCESS/FAILURE marker state.
gaps.gate: Pure FACT with a product-anchor clause: fire = (dir has expected.txt) AND NOT(MUST_RUN OR EXPECT) AND (SUCCESS present, no FAILURE). The SUCCESS-without-FAILURE clause isolates the dangerous false-green subset from merely-deferred TODOs.
gaps.fires_on: LATENT TODAY: 9 dirs match the orphan shape (verified: e.g. 430_003_impl_override_only, 365_001_basic_intercept), but all 9 are FAILURE so the gate correctly holds. Flips to alarm the instant one compiles and gets a SUCCESS marker with its expected.txt still unchecked.

gaps.title: Hand-authored doc code blocks must compile against the live compiler (stderr-gated, not exit-code)
gaps.intent: Every fenced ```koru/```kz block in hand-authored Markdown (README first) must use only forms the current koruc accepts — the front door a new user copies must not be dead syntax.
gaps.faucet: FACT: extract fenced koru/kz blocks from hand-authored .md (exclude files with a 'Generated by' header), write each to a temp .kz, run zig-out/bin/koruc, and fire on any block whose STDERR contains `error[`. CRITICAL: koruc exits 0 even on PARSE003 (verified), so gate on stderr `error[` match, never on exit code.
gaps.gate: Pure FACT: fire = N_failing_blocks >= 1 in any non-generated doc. Compiler is the oracle.
gaps.fires_on: TODAY: README.md:6 block → `error[PARSE003]: imports are bare — drop the ~` (verified live; also uses dead `std.io:` dot-namespace pinned by KORU035). Canonical form is bare `import std/io`.

gaps.title: A behavior-changing fix(...) under src/ must land with a regression test
gaps.intent: CONTRIBUTING/AGENTS both mandate failing-test-first; a src/ behavior fix with no tests/ change ships a change with zero pinned evidence.
gaps.faucet: FACT: for each `^fix` commit, `git show --name-only`; flag if it touches src/*.zig but no path under tests/. INTENT axis fix_is_test_pinned: +1 the diff adds/updates a regression exercising the fixed path, -1 a behavior-changing fix lands with no test and no stated untestability reason.
gaps.gate: fire = FACT(fix touches src/, not tests/) × INTENT(fix_is_test_pinned <= -0.5) × gain >= floor. Judge suppresses docs/snapshot-only fix commits and fixes already covered by an existing re-run test.
gaps.fires_on: VERIFIED: b203f6cb `fix(codegen): unbalanced closer...` touches only src/codegen_utils.zig, zero tests/. Control d87beceb `fix(parser): reject unbalanced...` lands with its tests/regression/100_081 — FACT half silent.
